title: IDF Demolishes Hezbollah Tunnel Network Beneath Beaufort Ridge
detail: The Israeli military destroyed a major underground Hezbollah tunnel network beneath the Beaufort Ridge using roughly 700 tons of explosives, in response to a Hezbollah drone strike on an IDF bulldozer a day earlier. Netanyahu and Katz said the multi-level network, built over two decades and previously serving as a command center for Hezbollah's Badr Unit, would no longer threaten Israel. The demolition had been postponed after the June framework agreement but was carried out once troops finished clearing the site.

title: President Aoun Visits Ankara; Erdogan Offers Turkish Role in Post-UNIFIL Force
detail: President Joseph Aoun made a one-day visit to Ankara, his first since taking office and the first visit by a Lebanese head of state to Turkey in 17 years. Aoun called on Turkey to help secure a full Israeli withdrawal from south Lebanon. Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan told Aoun that Ankara was ready to join a security arrangement in south Lebanon once UNIFIL's mandate ends later in 2026.

media.caption: President Aoun meets Turkish President Erdogan in Ankara
